question: Does the Medium-versus-Max reasoning-effort pattern observed on five historical BugsInPy repairs replicate on five newly constructed software defects that were withheld from Devin before execution?
secondary_questions: Does additional reasoning effort improve behavioral repair success on the novel cases?
How do Medium and Max compare on wall time, observable steps, observable tool calls, prompt tokens, completion tokens, source patch size, and generated/environment workspace churn?
Do visible-test success and held-out behavioral success ever disagree?
Does the historical E002 pattern appear similar or different on the novel E003 set?
intervention_policy: zero substantive assistance; no retries for ordinary task failures
success_rule: TASK_SUCCESS is 1 only when public, held-out behavioral, and regression suites all pass; evaluator infrastructure errors are recorded separately as EVALUATION_ERROR.

limits.session_termination: terminate at 3600 seconds or when Devin exits; close the session before evaluator access
limits.infrastructure_timeout_behavior: classify a watchdog/service timeout as infrastructure only when the harness or service is at fault; an agent that reaches the limit is an agent outcome

capture: UTC start/end and elapsed wall time
observable steps, tool calls, prompt tokens, completion tokens, usage, cost, and ACUs when available
stdout, stderr, session export, termination reason
final filesystem patch and source/generated workspace churn
public, held-out, and regression evaluator results

isolation.credentials: minimum Devin credential file only, read-only
isolation.network: E002 internal network and restricted Devin-service proxy; no dependency installation during agent session
isolation.evaluator: outside the container and unavailable until the session is closed

novelty_boundary: The E003 benchmark instances, defect implementations, prompts, reference fixes, and held-out behavioral evaluations were newly constructed for this experiment and withheld from Devin until the protocol was frozen and execution began. Training-data absence is not claimed.
embargo: Private case source, fixed source, reference patches, held-out tests, and solution metadata remain outside the public repository until all ten E003 runs are closed.
